title: fix(plugin-auth, console): the OAuth consent page names where the grant goes and marks a client no administrator registered as unverified
body:
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：OAuth 授权同意页除了应用自报的名称和图标外，还显示授权码将被发往的目的地（服务端从已签名的授权请求中读出的 redirect 主机），并把不是平台管理员注册的应用（包括动态注册的应用）标为“未经验证”。
- 为什么改：应用名称和图标是注册时应用自己填的，不能单独作为用户批准的身份；用户应看到授权实际去往哪里，以及该应用是否由管理员登记。
- 风险与回滚：新增一个需要登录的只读接口 `POST /api/v1/auth/oauth-consent/request`；在服务端确认目的地之前“授权”按钮不可用，“拒绝”始终可用。回滚即撤销本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/oauth-consent-request.ts`（签名校验之后才读 redirect、管理员判定）；`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/OAuthConsentPage.tsx`（未确认时禁用授权、未验证标记）；`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/oauth-consent-request.real-plugin.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/OAuthConsentPage.public-client-12301.test.tsx`，预期 22 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The OAuth consent page never lets the client's self-declared name stand alone as the identity a person approves:

- **It names where the grant goes.** A new session-required read, `POST /api/v1/auth/oauth-consent/request` with body `{ oauth_query }`, answers `{ clientId, redirectUri, registeredByAdministrator }`. `redirectUri` is read from the signed authorization request only after the provider's own signature check (the check `/oauth2/consent` runs), so it is the redirect `/oauth2/authorize` validated and the one a consent sends the code to; it is never read from a client-supplied display field or from the client's registration metadata. The page shows the host (with its port) of an `http(s)` redirect, a loopback one included, and any other redirect, such as a native app's custom scheme, as it is.
- **It marks a client no platform administrator registered as unverified.** `registeredByAdministrator` is `true` only when the account the stored client names as its registrant holds platform-admin standing (ADR-0068 D2, read through `hasPlatformAdminStanding`, fail-closed). A dynamically registered client, with or without a session, and a client another account registered through a self-service door read `false`; the page marks them as an unverified application and names the destination in the mark. A client an administrator registered is shown without the mark. Whether dynamic registration itself is narrowed is not changed here.
- **Authorize waits for the destination.** Until the server answers, and whenever it cannot, Authorize is disabled and the page says the destination could not be confirmed. Deny always works.
- The read's refusals carry ADR-0112 code and status: no session `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`; a held session `403` with its posture's code; any query parameter, a body key other than `oauth_query`, an empty query, or a request this server did not sign or whose signature expired `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`; a body that does not parse `400 INVALID_REQUEST`; a client the provider does not serve `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. Every answer is `Cache-Control: no-store`. The route is entered in the auth route ledger.
- Every new string goes through the console's i18n in all 11 shipped locales (`en`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`, `ja`, `ar`, `de`, `es`, `fr`, `ko`, `pt-BR`, `ru`); none of them is a generated bundle.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/oauth-consent-request.real-plugin.test.ts` (real `AuthManager`, real provider, real route registration, signed query taken from the provider's own authorize redirect): the answer's redirect is the signed one; a request whose bytes differ from what the provider signed is refused; a client registered dynamically with no credential and a client a non-administrator registered through the Setup door both read `registeredByAdministrator: false`; a client a platform administrator registered reads `true`; session, closed body, closed query and the `404` are pinned with code and status.
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/OAuthConsentPage.public-client-12301.test.tsx` (new top-level `describe` in the existing harness): a dynamically registered client is marked unverified with the destination named; an administrator-registered client is shown without the mark; the destination shown is the server's, never a redirect the client declared; loopback, localhost, custom-scheme and reverse-domain redirects are named as the rule says; Authorize is disabled while unanswered and on every unconfirmed answer, Deny never is.
- `auth-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts` holds the new route to the ledger's proof.

## Acceptance notes

- "Registered by an administrator" is judged by the registering account's current platform-admin standing. A client registered by an account that later loses that standing is shown as unverified from then on.
- The console's `type-check` for `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n` could not be measured locally (the `ui/` packages' `dist` was not built in this container); `Type Check UI` in CI is the reading of record.

## Verification

- `@objectstack/plugin-auth`: `build`, `typecheck`, full `test`: exit 0; Test Files 254 passed, Tests 4574 passed, 10 skipped.
- `@object-ui/console` suite (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/`): Test Files 309 passed, Tests 3114 passed.
- `@object-ui/i18n` suite (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/`): Test Files 101 passed, Tests 1848 passed, 13 skipped (all-locales key parity included).
- Ablation, one shot each, committed first and restored from `HEAD` (blob hashes equal to `HEAD` after restore, `git diff HEAD` empty): the server's administrator judgement replaced by "any registering account" turned the server pin red (1 failed of 10), then restored; the page's unverified mark removed turned the component pins red (5 failed of 22), then restored.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 81 commands): 79 exit 0; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` exit 3 (prerequisite not met: whole-tree `dist` / lock queue), NOT MEASURED, left to CI. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` had 3 tests time out on the shared box; those 3 files re-run under the verify lock: 67 passed. `--ran` reconciliation: 81 derived, 79 run, 2 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.
